name: Melilot
message: 「Hello. Do you have business at the library?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes. I came to return the materials I borrowed the other day, actually」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is that so. Right on time, as expected」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I am the Student Council President, after all」

name: Melilot
message: 「I really wish the other students would follow your example, Sakura-kun」
Getting praised for something I just took for granted feels kind of ticklish.

name: Synn
message: 「By the way, what's going on with all those books?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Ah... these are something I was asked to bring」
Adjusting her grip on the armful of books, Melilot-san lets out a small sigh.

name: Synn
message: 「Where are you taking them? If you'd like, I can help」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's only to the Chairwoman's office, so it's hardly any trouble」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san does seem pretty busy, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Looking out for Helena-san like that--you're really kind, Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「...We've simply known each other for a long time, that's all」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, let me help you after all」

name: Synn
message: 「The meeting ended early today, so it's fine」
Until the rest of the work starts, it's break time.

name: Melilot
message: 「...They're all thick books, so they're quite heavy, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「All the more reason I can't just leave you to carry them」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then I'll take you up on your kind offer and ask you to take just half」

name: Synn
message: 「We've got clear autumn skies today, huh」

name: Melilot
message: 「Though I'm not particularly fond of strong sunlight...」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I don't really go out walking around during the day like this very often, you see」

name: Synn
message: 「Your skin is really pale, after all, Melilot-san」

name: Melilot
message: 「...I don't think that has anything to do with it」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... shall I carry a bit more?」
Come to think of it, she usually carries about this much for her regular work anyway...

name: Synn
message: 「You suddenly started acting restless, so I wondered if something happened...」

name: Melilot
message: 「L-Like I said, it's nothing at all!」
It's almost like she's on guard against something, though...

name: Melilot
message: 「G-G-G-Get it off! Please get it off! H-H-H-Hurry!」

name: Melilot
message: 「P-Please, I'm begging you, get it off right now!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then, could you just hold still for a second...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Kyaaaaah! No! Please don't come any closer!」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you expect me to do!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「I can't take it, I really can't! Please get it off, get it off me!?」
While he hesitated like that, the mischievous ladybug made its way onto Melilot-san's chest.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, um, it's just in a really awkward spot to reach, oh man, this is turning into a huge mess...」
Pressed between both arms and pushed up by the books she was holding, there was only one place his eyes could go.
Before long, the enemy sank straight into that soft valley.

name: Melilot
message: 「Kyaah! No! Sakura-kun, any further and I really can't take it!」
It was the kind of scream that would definitely cause a misunderstanding if anyone else saw them.

name: Synn
message: 「P-Please stay still. It'll be over in a second...」
Having made a narrow escape at the last second, the ladybug returned straight to the open sky.
Was that good luck, or bad luck...

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah! I was just checking, I swear! You're totally fine!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I seem to have shown you an unsightly side of myself」
She's so composed it's as if nothing ever happened.

name: Synn
message: 「Um, could it be... you're not good with bugs?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, everyone has at least one thing they can't handle, right?」

name: Melilot
message: 「As I said, what are you talking about...」

name: Synn
message: 「I think something like a ladybug is pretty cute, though...」

name: Melilot
message: 「They are not cute! Bugs are all the same!」
So she really can't stand bugs after all.
Still, I have to hand it to her for not letting go of her book even while panicking that much.

name: Melilot
message: 「I must ask that you keep this strictly confidential, understood...?」

name: Synn
message: 「I swear I won't tell a soul」

name: Melilot
message: 「I can trust you on that, yes?」

name: Synn
message: 「I never go back on my word to the Student Council President!」
So even Melilot-san, who's usually so cool, has a side like that.
Thinking that probably no one else has ever seen it makes me feel like I got a little lucky.
